construction.findings: Source audit confirms muted NLA, cleared active actions and rest state. Stationary root and nonnegative clearance within numeric tolerance pass across 121 samples per clip. Surface and shadow coverage terminate cleanly; resource disposal restores original materials and geometry. The shader masks retracted alternate checkbox geometry while reading, never modifying, the three morph weights. All eight combinations preserve their supplied state.

readability.findings: Inspected close Spawn at 50 percent and Resolve at 65 percent, then phone Spawn at 50 and Resolve at 80 percent. Mint outline follows the document cut corner; the upward fill exposes empty gray checkboxes with no hidden green tiles. The separate completion tick and three narrow ribbons remain readable. Inspected exact phone endpoint: no body, helper or shadow remains.

Inspector playback, exact endpoints, deterministic seeking, restart, clamp, Rest reset and paused reload pass. Existing idle, move, checklist_progress clip values/timing are byte-identical to the baseline. Both use the existing 0.18 m ready hover; progress animation remains independently controlled.
